title: Win32 Job membership: suspended process, atomic JOB_LIST, assignment proof, resume, unwind, real-Windows acceptance
description:
SPIDR child 2 of 2, split from task-ea76e0cf9bdb4f1888aaa9e49323c782 by architect-cb476f76 on plan shape: the parent needs 12 distinct files against the daemon's hard ceiling of 10, and its job and process modules would each breach the 250-line per-file target.

DEPENDS ON task-a24cb925a9a94002b805e9ccf1715978 (child 1: pinned crate, call-table seam, RAII handles, Job create/configure/query-back/terminate/active-query). Do not start until that task is DONE, and re-measure its landed symbols before planning rather than trusting this description. This task adds process-side modules to the crate child 1 creates; it must not re-create the crate, the call table, the handle type, or any Job operation child 1 owns.

Objective: put a process inside the Job without a crash window, prove it is really there before it can run, and unwind correctly when any step fails.

Deliverable, inside packages/runner/src/platform/windows/native/: src/process.rs (CreateProcessW with CREATE_SUSPENDED, explicit lpApplicationName, Unicode environment, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST carrying the Job, a restricted three-handle inherited allowlist, then an explicit AssignProcessToJobObject confirmation, membership proof, live-handle identity proof, and ResumeThread asserting a prior suspend count of exactly 1); src/lifecycle.rs (wait, exit query, terminate, ActiveProcesses==0 query, and reverse-order unwind of partial construction); edits to src/lib.rs and src/win32.rs to add the process-side call-table arms; tests/process_sweep.rs; tests/real_windows.rs.

The atomic JOB_LIST membership removes the pre-assignment crash window, while the explicit AssignProcessToJobObject call preserves the separately testable assign-failure arm the parent DoD requires. Supported floor is Windows 10 / Server 2016.

NOT in scope: Node/stdio framing, JavaScript hostile-input validation, Claude discovery/grants, daemon/store authority, receipts, or any public @moe/runner export.

Production consumer: task-af3d7bc8af2146cf92d98557ed0e90c0 (Windows Job broker protocol, which names the parent task explicitly), then task-4d1f8ba54cb6476c930c46b413f882aa.

Verification: cargo test --locked --manifest-path packages/runner/src/platform/windows/native/Cargo.toml --target-dir dist/windows-job-native -p moe-windows-job-core && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path packages/runner/src/platform/windows/native/Cargo.toml --target-dir dist/windows-job-native -p moe-windows-job-core
definitionOfDone: A production call-trace test proves the exact order: prepare JOB_LIST plus the three-handle inherited allowlist, CreateProcessW suspended with explicit lpApplicationName and Unicode environment, explicitly AssignProcessToJobObject, prove membership, prove live-handle identity, then ResumeThread with a prior suspend count of exactly 1.

The lifecycle API retains the original Job, process and thread handles rather than reopening by PID, returns PID plus creation-time and final-image identity, and never reports started, exited or tree-dead before the matching membership, identity, exit or ActiveProcesses==0 fact has been queried successfully.

An injected call-table sweep exercises every attribute-prepare, create, assign, membership, identity, resume, wait, exit-query, terminate, active-query and close arm, asserts the exact stable native operation code per arm, asserts a nonzero exact case count, and proves no resume can occur before the membership proof succeeds.

Every partial-construction fault unwinds in reverse acquisition order: pre-membership children are terminated and awaited directly; post-membership failures terminate the Job and wait for ActiveProcesses==0; every acquired handle closes exactly once and a cleanup whose outcome is unknown is retained as uncertain rather than converted to success.

Focused real Windows tests prove a suspended marker process cannot execute before the membership and assignment proof, and that terminating the configured Job leaves zero active processes; tests launch a direct executable plus argv and never use taskkill, a command shell, or PID-enumeration-only cleanup.

Every Rust production source is <=250 physical lines; child 1's crate, call table, handle type and Job operations are reused unchanged rather than reimplemented, and the locked test and release-build commands exit 0 with no committed target, executable, debug or probe artifact.
taskRails: Use the Windows 10+/Server 2016+ PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST crash-atomic membership path, followed by the explicit AssignProcessToJobObject confirmation before resume.
Native failures carry a closed operation enum and numeric Win32 error only; never echo executable, argv, cwd, environment, or raw handle values.
Keep every Rust production source focused, target <=250 physical lines and split before 400; commit Cargo.lock but never Cargo target output or binaries.
This is a native primitive, not authority: no @moe/runner root export, Claude policy, activation grant, daemon/store call, or evidence claim.
Reuse child 1's crate, call-table trait, RAII handle and Job operations; do not recreate or fork them.

WHY THE SPLIT HAPPENED, for the record: this shell re-measured to 10 distinct affectedFiles and 12 plan steps -- both exactly at the daemon hard ceiling -- once three facts were measured on disk that its description had wrong. win32.rs had shipped at 252 lines, already over this task's own DoD bar. tests/job_sweep.rs cross-checked NativeOp::ALL and would break on any new variant, making it an unnamed 10th file. And the described extraction path for the module split was wrong in a way that would have forced import rewrites. The human confirmed the split in the REPL before either child was created.

NOTE FOR ANYONE AUDITING COMMITS: the crate's bytes are spread across several commits, three of them foreign whole-tree sweeps (6daa942, c199088, and others). That is the known completion-hook hazard, not a defect of either child, and per project rail it is never a rejection reason. Review by base-ref diff over owned paths, never by looking for a commit bearing a task id.

The grandparent shell task-ea76e0cf9bdb4f1888aaa9e49323c782 remains BLOCKED and is a separate closure decision -- it has other children beyond this branch.
